steps.title: You can continue to do bird …
steps.text: You can continue to do bird house runs as you would like. Having the Mounted digsite pendant in your house makes this much easier. — The guide also assumes you will have Hespori for death banking now, but Nightmare is still an option until you get that. — If you are struggling to get a Hespori seed, you can open seed packs from Tithe Farm to go for one that way too.

steps.title: (Optional) Now that you have Hunter …
steps.text: (Optional) Now that you have Hunter started, you could choose to death bank and do Hunter Rumours at any point. — The main benefit of this would be to have a higher Prayer level for the guide. — The reason we don't do this now is simply to wait for a fairy ring in your POH and it being easier to use up the loot after you have progressed a bit more, but the difference is minor.

steps.text: Complete Shades of Morton

steps.title: Complete the easy Karamja Diary
steps.text: Complete the easy Karamja Diary

steps.title: You should have at least 30 …
steps.text: You should have at least 30 Herblore by now, if you don't you might need to make a few potions with your bagged herbs to get it

steps.title: Complete Shilo Village
steps.text: Complete Shilo Village

steps.title: Complete One Small Favor
steps.text: Complete One Small Favor

steps.title: Obtain the Rogue equipment set. — …
steps.text: Obtain the Rogue equipment set. — Move your house to Taverley. — Death bank at Hespori. — Minigame teleport to Burthorpe. — Play the Rogues' Den. — As you get pieces, walk to your house and store them.

steps.title: Obtain a Fighter Torso while still …
steps.text: Obtain a Fighter Torso while still death banked. — DO NOT get your rune pouch and runes out! You can't bring it in with you. — The torso can be stored in your house when not in use.

steps.title: Grab your ranarr weeds out of …
steps.text: Grab your ranarr weeds out of death bank and make Prayer potions. — You can collect Snape grass on the shore east of of Hosidius and note it at the grape vine farm nearby. — Make the potions at the Grand Exchange and note them there. See this video for a quick tutorial. — Keep these potions on you for questing. — Keep 1 unfinished potion for the next quest.

steps.title: You can collect your items from …
steps.text: You can collect your items from death bank now. — Don't forget to move your house back to Hosidius

steps.title: If you got fossils from Ammonite …
steps.text: If you got fossils from Ammonite crabs you can hand them in for lamps

steps.title: Complete His Faithful Servants for a …
steps.text: Complete His Faithful Servants for a quick 20k Prayer xp

steps.title: Complete Eadgar's Ruse. — You can …
steps.text: Complete Eadgar's Ruse. — You can wait

steps.title: collect the grain and chicken during …
steps.text: collect the grain and chicken during the quest

steps.title: Complete My Arm's Big Adventure. — …
steps.text: Complete My Arm's Big Adventure. — Make sure to start the supercompost before starting the favor grind

steps.title: Complete the 5 Kourend quests. Put …
steps.text: Complete the 5 Kourend quests. Put each paper in your Kharedst's memoirs. — The Depths of Despair — The Queen of Thieves — The Ascent of Arceuus — The Forsaken Tower — Tale of the Righteous

steps.title: Complete Eagles' Peak
steps.text: Complete Eagles' Peak

steps.title: Complete the Kourend and Kebos easy …
steps.text: Complete the Kourend and Kebos easy and medium diaries

steps.title: Complete the easy combat achievements. — …
steps.text: Complete the easy combat achievements. — You should have a lot of points already from Wintertodt and Tempoross. — All of the achievements from Brutus. — The Speed trial can be done with a Dragon Halberd if you want to go for it. You will need to do Regicide now, but that is fine. — Some quick tasks to consider: — Weed Whacker — A Greater Foe with Darklight to also get Not So Great After All — Into the Den of Giants — Mage of the Swamp — I'd Rather Be Illiterate — Avoiding Those Little Arms — Perfect Scurrius — Scurrius Novice — Author Note: Let me know if there are any other easy Achievements to go for I missed.

steps.title: You should have 45 Herblore by …
steps.text: You should have 45 Herblore by now

steps.title: (Optional) Make some Super attack potions …
steps.text: (Optional) Make some Super attack potions to go with your Dragon Battleaxe. — Keep in mind you can use the normal Attack and Defense potions from the Warriors Guild to offset the Battleaxe stat drain.

steps.title: Go to the Warriors Guild and …
steps.text: Go to the Warriors Guild and get a Rune Defender. — Using Black Armour is pretty good for collecting tokens. You can buy all the pieces in shops. — Make sure to show the defender to Lorelai downstairs so you won't need to get it again later. — Bones to Peaches is really helpful here. — Don't get a Dragon Defender unless you have 60 Defense to use it.

steps.title: Complete Family Crest
steps.text: Complete Family Crest

steps.title: Complete Underground Pass. — Alch the …
steps.text: Complete Underground Pass. — Alch the staff after the quest. Don't upgrade it now, you will need the staff again later and you can upgrade it

steps.title: Complete Legends Quest. — Complete this …
steps.text: Complete Legends Quest. — Complete this quest one section at a time. Don't try to collect all the items at the start. — Of course use all the xp on Herblore. Be careful not to select the wrong skill.

steps.title: Complete Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik …
steps.text: Complete Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze. — Make sure to collect all the items up front, as the unfinished dishes are lost on death and you need to get to Entrana

steps.title: Complete A Kingdom Divided. — You …
steps.text: Complete A Kingdom Divided. — You need to actually prepare for the Xamphur fight, it is difficult with these stats. — You don't need to collect the defence potion, volcanic sulphur, molten glass, or dark essence block until after the fight.

steps.title: Steal from master farmers until you …
steps.text: Steal from master farmers until you get 4-6 limpwurt seeds. Farm them for 20 limpwurt roots. — Remember to use the Rogue's outfit. — You can also use up any other seeds you get, for example planting watermelon seeds or a Mushroom spore for diary steps later.

steps.title: Complete Temple of Ikov. — You …
steps.text: Complete Temple of Ikov. — You do not need a bow, just use steel knives from the Martin Thwait's Lost and Found with ice arrows in your ammo slot

steps.title: Complete Desert Treasure I. — Do …
steps.text: Complete Desert Treasure I. — Do not overprepare for the fights. Just bring magic, some prayer potions, and a bit of food for the first 3 fights. For Kamil you do want a good amount of food though. — Fareed : Protection from melee and manual cast water spells. Super easy. — Damis : Bring runes for snare and kite him, or setup the safespot. — Dessous : Flick between pray range and pray melee each tick and he won't attack at all. — Kamil : Make 2 restore potions and use fire spells. Bring extra food for this fight. Also, use fire spells on the ice trolls. — You should have some Harrlander seeds in your seed box that you can farm while getting the other diamonds. — Keep the Ring of visibility. — You will need to briefly visit Entrana.

steps.title: Complete Curse of the Empty Lord. …
steps.text: Complete Curse of the Empty Lord. — Get your lamp from Historian Minas. — This might take you to Entrana

steps.title: (Optional) You can make more portal …
steps.text: (Optional) You can make more portal rooms and add the Ancient spellbook portals to your house now if you would like. — I like having an upstairs area with all of the Ancients teleports together above the other portal rooms, but it is up to you.

steps.title: Complete the Recipe for Disaster/Defeating the …
steps.text: Complete the Recipe for Disaster/Defeating the Culinaromancer. — The videos have a setup to use. — Buy some Barrows Gloves

steps.title: Complete Fairy Tale Part II. — …
steps.text: Complete Fairy Tale Part II. — You can now tea boost to put a fairy ring in your house. — Get the mushrooms from Sulliusceps
